coupling: The case-equivalence maintenance commit adds a source-order-preserving scan for long Unicode ignore-case lookbehind alternatives. Its temporary key array reserves one slot per alternative but writes an end sentinel after the last slot. The later lookbehind maintenance commit invokes that backward scan while continuing to skip sorting and rationalization. Without the first edit the invoked scan has no out-of-bounds write; without the second edit the backward scan is not reached. A long lookbehind of distinct one-character alternatives drives the sentinel write into the ASan-poisoned zone redzone.
